name: temporal association with opportunity correction
hypothesis: A same-length scan reference over independently shifted predicate traces improves VCMR beyond whole-query CLIP and raw joint-support controls.
controls: same baseline plus raw simultaneous conjunction
selection: dev_select only; beta on whole-query control, then separate gamma grids on raw conjunction and corrected conjunction; tie-break lower complexity after R1@.7
confirmation: dev_confirm; no parameter changes on this cohort. Primary R1@.5, paired video-cluster bootstrap2000; report R1@.7 and full ranks.
success: Positive paired95% confidence interval against the strongest control selected on dev_select, and at least0.25percentagepoint gain. Otherwise no demonstrated benefit under this experiment; negative upper interval is evidence of harm.
limitations: backbone pretrained on original training set, including development episodes
global CLIP features cannot verify actor identity
retained development cohort excludes unavailable train HERO ranks; final officialval remains complete
